title: Trump Open to Putin Attending Florida G20 Summit: 'I'd Like to Have Him'
snippet: President Donald Trump indicated he would welcome Russian President Vladimir Putin to next month's G20 summit in Florida, though the Kremlin says no final decision has been made.
content:
PALM BEACH, Fla. — President Donald Trump signaled Thursday that Russian President Vladimir Putin is welcome to attend the upcoming G20 summit in South Florida, telling reporters over the Thanksgiving holiday that he would personally like to see the Russian leader present.

Speaking from his Mar-a-Lago club in Palm Beach, Trump addressed speculation surrounding Putin's attendance at the Dec. 14-15 gathering of world leaders. "If he wanted to come, he certainly can," Trump said, while acknowledging the diplomatic friction such a visit might cause. "If it were up to me, I'd like to have him."

Kremlin Weighs Summit Attendance

Despite Trump's open-door stance, the president noted he doubts Putin will ultimately choose to travel to the United States, pointing out that several international counterparts would likely object to his presence. The Kremlin confirmed on Thursday that no official decision has been reached regarding Putin’s travel plans.

Putin previously remarked following a bilateral meeting with Trump that he would consider attending after further discussions with the U.S. president, though he emphasized that domestic priorities within Russia would play a key role in his final choice.

Diplomatic Push Regarding Ukraine

The summit discussion comes amid ongoing global focus on the conflict in Eastern Europe. Earlier in the day, Trump posted on Truth Social expressing his desire to see Russia reduce its military aggression across European territories, framing the move as a crucial step toward achieving a swift peace settlement in Ukraine.
